what: Worker log lines saying a line aired as text when it could have had audio, one per group and line, per revision.
source: Log Analytics workspace log-earshot, table ContainerAppConsoleLogs, each revision's whole life (warm-up and load tests included)
query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs | where ContainerAppName == "ca-earshot-worker" and TimeGenerated > datetime(2026-10-16T12:00:00Z) | where RevisionName endswith "0000017" or RevisionName endswith "0000018" or RevisionName endswith "0000019" or RevisionName endswith "0000020" | where Log has "audio failed" or Log has "speech failed" or Log has "speech unavailable" | extend reason = case(Log has "live-audio" and Log has ".wav", "shared scratch WAV (fixed in #28)", Log has ".part", "shared TTS .part file (fixed in #30)", Log has "(serve:", "started line skipped as stale (fixed in #30)", Log has "AAC encoder", "no AAC encoder", Log has "speech unavailable", "speech unavailable (cached-only or budget)", "other") | summarize n=count() by RevisionName, reason

ca-earshot-worker--0000020.logged: from 00:36 UTC (queried 01:2x, after its load test)

notes: The worker logs warnings only, so a revision with no rows here logged no failure; revision 0000020 logged only its 4 startup lines.

'no AAC encoder' (2, revision 0000017): encode_aac reports any ffmpeg failure that way and drops ffmpeg's error, so the cause cannot be told; a missing input WAV from the shared-scratch race is one way to get it.
'other' (3, revision 0000017): 'speech failed' with an empty error message, one line in three groups.
The load test times only lines that have audio, so the runs on revisions 0000017 and 0000018 are missing these lines from their latency samples.
